pairs.why: Nearly identical, but B's canopy and lace are slightly smoother and cleaner, while A shows faint fabric mottling. That matches the lessons' preference for the smooth-but-not-plastic finish.
A's canopy is darker and has a little more cloth grain. B's brighter, smoother purple with soft highlights is closer to the clean finish of the real fan and umbrella.
A has a pinkish sheen and slightly grainy fabric. B reads as the smoother, evenly lit soft shape that the real cards use.
A's lace and canopy are a bit more textured and detailed. B keeps the simpler, smoother rendering that the texture lessons favor.
A shows faint fabric texture and a hazier highlight. B's cleaner, smoother canopy is closer to the real cards' finish.
A has visibly woven-looking, darker fabric and a more realistic handle collar, which is the too-textured look from the lessons. B is smoother and brighter, like the real cards.
A's canopy has slightly more cloth grain and heavier shading. B's smoother, saturated purple sits closer to the real fan's clean finish.
The two are almost the same, but A carries a little more surface texture on the canopy. B's smoother finish fits the real cards better.
